Context: Fires before 1960 when VIE_CuongDe_Lost1 flag is set — marks the political failure or death of Cuong De. Conditional title/desc: VIE sees one version of the event; JAP sees another. Option A grants VIE stability; Option B is JAP-specific outcome. Both tags must have their perspective written separately.

First diplomatic event in the CD_Nhiep PM chain. JAP (Japan as Vietnamese patron) receives an initial diplomatic cable from VIE under PM Nguyen De Nhiep. Single option — grants +15 PP to JAP and immediately chains to CD_Nhiep.3 for VIE. Pure notification/bridge event.

VIE receives Japan's response under the Nhiep PM track. Adds conservative ideology popularity; applies opinion modifiers between VIE and JAP; adjusts internal influence/favoritism variables. Part of the Japan-Vietnam diplomatic alignment in the CuongDe playthrough.

JAP decision event about investing in the Phu Xuan (Hue area) Metro project. Option A: JAP pays, commits to construction, triggers CD_Nhiep.6. Option B: JAP declines, VIE loses opinion of JAP, triggers CD_Nhiep.8. This is the key branching decision in the infrastructure investment sub-chain.

JAP commits to funding the Phu Xuan Metro. Costs Japan money. Schedules CD_Nhiep.7 (metro completion event) with a 730-day delay (2 years). A narrative bridge event confirming the investment decision.

Phu Xuan Metro completed. Fires 2 years after CD_Nhiep.6. Grants JAP +125 PP and +15% stability; upgrades state 1758 (Hue/Phu Xuan) with infrastructure and powerplant; adds train equipment. Major payoff event for the investment chain.
JAP refuses the Phu Xuan Metro investment. Minor consequence event — single option that deducts 45 PP from JAP as a diplomatic cost for declining. No follow-on events.

Tourism infrastructure completion event for state 1758 (Hue/Phu Xuan area). Single option that adds tourism-related infrastructure and victory points to the state. Reward event for a completed development project in the CuongDe-Nhiep PM track.

FUL National Focuses Triggers it. / First of a two-event annexation sequence. VIE triggers CD_Annexation.2 for itself after 100 days. Pure bridge/delay event — no mechanical effects of its own. Fires during the CuongDe path when VIE moves to annex a minor territory (likely Cochinchina/FUL).

VIE formally annexes territory (likely Cochinchina / FUL tag). Grants +100 PP and transfers all FUL troops to VIE control. The actual mechanical annexation event that fires 100 days after CD_Annexation.1. Major game state change

News event (fires for all countries) marking the beginning of CuongDe's succession crisis. Single option. The .0 variant fires first — introduces the succession question to the world. Localization exists but picture GFX is missing.
News event (fires for all countries) — one of two successor outcome variants. Marks a specific resolution path for who succeeds Cuong De. Single option. Localization exists.
News event (fires for all countries) — the alternative successor outcome variant (fired by a different branch than .100). Marks the other resolution path. Single option. Localization exists.

Early CuongDe event — fires when he is first consolidating power. Single-option informational event. Part of the initial event chain after VIE_CuongDe_Succeeds flag is set. Bridge narrative event introducing Cuong De to the player.

Three-option branching event during Cuong De's early consolidation. Player chooses Cuong De's initial political approach (options A/B/C suggest three different stances). Sets the tone for the CuongDe playthrough early game.

VIN's reaction to CuongDe gaining power. Single option. Increases France's Indochina Struggle variables (Pro-Independence score and Communist score) by 100 each — representing that CuongDe's nationalist government galvanizes political pressures on French Indochina policy.

Similar to NV_CuongDe.1 but a stronger version — increases France's Indochina Struggle variables by 200. Fires in a different scenario or later stage. Represents escalating pressure on French policy from CuongDe's stronger nationalist position.

Key decision event for VIE approaching VIN about peaceful reunification under CuongDe. Two options: if VIE has good opinion with VIN → peaceful reunification path (triggers .2); if bad opinion → rejection and confrontation (triggers .6). Player-facing choice.
VIN notification event — receives VIE's reunification proposal. Single option that fires NV_CuongDe_Unification.4 for VIE after 6 hours. Pure bridge event from VIN's perspective.

VIE sends the formal rejection of reunification talks to VIN. Single option that triggers NV_CuongDe_Unification.7 for VIN after 12 hours. Marks the breakdown of negotiations in the confrontational path.

VIN receives VIE's rejection of reunification. Opinion effects applied: decreases between VIE and VIN based on country existence checks. Complex outcome event marking the diplomatic fallout of failed talks.
First event in the USA-VIE diplomatic chain. USA receives an initial opportunity regarding Vietnam. Single option — triggers USA_VIE.2 after 1 day. Pure bridge event

Key USA decision event: two options for how to engage VIE. Option A completes a USA 50s focus and triggers USA_VIE.3 for VIE (full engagement); Option B adds opinion modifier with FRA (cautious approach). Core branching point of the USA-VIE relationship chain.
VIE receives the US diplomatic proposal. Single option. This is the first event that fires for VIE in the USA-VIE chain — VIE learns of American interest and support.
USA internal notification event following VIE engagement. Single option, informational. Part of the diplomatic chain back to USA's side.
USA proposes a deal to VIN (North Vietnam) as part of mediation efforts. Single option — triggers USA_VIE.6 for VIN after 1 day. Part of a broader US attempt to influence both Vietnams.

Critical VIN decision event: USA offers political incentives to the North. Two options: Option A changes VIN's politics to Social Democratic and triggers USA_VIE.8 for USA (cooperation path); Option B rejects and adds a negative opinion modifier (rejection path).
USA informed notification event — receives update on VIN's position. Single option, informational bridge in the chain.

USA arranges news coverage of the agreement and notifies FRA of the development. Single option — creates USA_VIE.9 (news event) and triggers USA_VIE.10 for FRA. Signals a successful diplomatic outcome.
News event (fires for all) — world press announces the US-Vietnam diplomatic breakthrough. Single option.
FRA (France) receives notification of the US-Vietnam deal. Single option, informational. France learns that the US is taking an active role in Indochina.
USA further engagement event — next step in the diplomatic chain. Single option, informational.
USA major decision or announcement event — has picture GFX_USA_VIE.12 defined. Single option. One of the more visible events in the chain given it has a custom picture assigned.
Final or late-stage USA event in the chain. Single option, informational.

Critical event — USA helps install Cuong De as VIE's head of state. Effects: -15% stability (political shock); loads the CuongDe focus tree; sets country flags; assigns Cuong De as country leader with democratic ruling party. This is the event that switches VIE to the CuongDe playthrough path.

US military and economic support package delivered to VIE after CuongDe's installation. Effects: sends equipment and money to VIE; applies opinion modifiers among USA/VIE/VIN; adjusts influence percentage. Uses GFX_Cuong_De (portrait of Cuong De) — verify this file exists.

USA initiates a reunification mediation process between VIN and VIE. Sets a flag and triggers USA_VIN_Reunification.2 for VIN after 7 days. Single option — USA starts the ball rolling on a negotiated reunification deal favoring the North.

VIN receives the American reunification proposal. Sets flags; triggers USA_VIN_Reunification.3 for USA and USA_VIN_Reunification.4 for VIE simultaneously. VIN agrees to participate. Bridge event coordinating multiple countries.
USA continuation event — orchestrating the reunification talks. Single option — triggers USA_VIN_Reunification.5 for VIN after 10 days. Part of the mediation timeline.

VIE decision event — the South must choose: accept US-mediated reunification under VIN, or resist. Option A accepts (leading to peaceful absorption); Option B resists (leading to a contested outcome). Player-facing choice with major consequences.

VIN formally absorbs VIE through US mediation (acceptance path). Effects: VIN gains states, annexes VIE and NLF, sets capital, triggers follow-on events (.7 and .8). Major game state change — Vietnam reunified under the North with American blessing.
Alternative reunification absorption (resistance path) — VIN gains states with an additional -10% stability penalty (due to VIE's resistance). Similar to .5 but harder. Also triggers .7 and .8.
USA applies final opinion modifiers after reunification — shows American backing and approval of the outcome. Single option. Diplomatic cleanup event.

Final reunification event for VIN. Sets global completion flag; drops cosmetic tag; dismantles faction; adjusts politics to Social Democratic with boosted popularity. VIN transformed into unified Vietnam.

Complex conditional event about the fate of Saigon (state 1285). Uses conditional title/desc keys (.ta/.tb/.tac/.tbc etc.) — each tag sees a different version. Four options each triggered by different country combinations controlling Saigon. This is a pivotal historical moment event about who controls southern Vietnam.

Historical event about the Buu-Nhu Syndicalist Alliance (Can Lao Party-adjacent political movement in South Vietnam). Two options: Option A adds stability and war support (embrace the alliance); Option B adds PP and adjusts influence (distance from it). A real political faction in 1950s South Vietnam.

First event in the Tran Van Huu PM track — JAP decides whether to support PM Huu. Two options: Option A triggers VIE_Huu.2 (support path); Option B triggers VIE_Huu.3 (decline path). Sets the tone for Japan's involvement in the Huu government.
VIE receives Japanese backing for PM Huu. Effects: VIE gains money; VIE opinion of JAP decreases (the dependence chafes). Part of the Japan-VIE partnership sub-chain under Huu

JAP decision event about a specific Phu Xuan (Hue area) infrastructure investment under PM Huu. Two options: Option A pays money and triggers VIE_Huu.6 for VIE; Option B gains PP and triggers VIE_Huu.7 (decline). Japan at a fork in its investment strategy.
VIE receives Japanese investment commitment under PM Huu. Effects: +25 PP, +5% stability, money, buildings in state; VIE-JAP opinion improves. Major positive outcome for the Japan investment path.

FRA decision event about investing in VIE under PM Huu. Two weighted options: Option A (15% chance) triggers VIE_Huu.11 for VIE; Option B (3% chance) triggers VIE_Huu.13. France being asked to help fund South Vietnam.

Second FRA decision event in the Huu investment chain. Two weighted options: Option A (20% chance) triggers VIE_Huu.12 for VIE; Option B (1% chance) triggers VIE_Huu.14. France deliberating again on investment levels.
FRA triggers VIE_Huu.13 for VIE (the better investment outcome). Single option — France commits to the development package. Part of the French investment chain under PM Huu.

VIE receives a mixed French investment: gains money and infrastructure (office park and infrastructure in a state) and improved FRA opinion and influence; but loses 10 PP (political cost of French dependence). Medium-level French support event.

VIE receives the best French investment package: gains +10 PP, money, office park and infrastructure, significantly improved FRA opinion, influence adjustment. Most positive outcome of the French investment chain.
VIE penalized: -50 PP and significantly decreased FRA opinion. The worst outcome of the French negotiation track — France withdraws or cuts relations with the Huu government.

Fires when NLF controls state 4401 (Saigon) and the Indochina War is ongoing. VIE does not control its own capital. Effects: -20% war support, -15% stability. A catastrophic event for South Vietnam. Current placeholder picture (GFX_KMT_Generic_Soldiers) is wrong and must be replaced.

Event in the Nguyen Van Tam PM track. Single option, informational/narrative. Tam served as PM 1952-1953 and was known for his hardline anti-communist stance and use of repression. Exact mechanical effects need verification from event file.
Bridge event in the Tran Quang Vinh PM track. VIE fires VIE_Vinh.5 after a 3-day delay. No direct effects — purely a timing mechanism. Part of the event chain setup for Vinh's PM tenure.

The Phuong Mutiny event — Nguyen Thanh Phuong (a Cochinchinese militia commander) launches a mutiny or political challenge during Vinh's PM tenure. Applies the Phuong Mutiny custom scripted effect. A dramatic moment of internal conflict.
End of the Phuong Mutiny — the crisis is resolved. Applies the end-Phuong-Mutiny custom tooltip effect. Resolution event following VIE_Vinh.3.

Key outcome event: Nguyen Thanh Phuong is retired/purged as a character. Effects: +5% stability; reduced neutrality popularity; adjusted favoritism and influence. Part of the resolution of the Phuong political crisis during Vinh's tenure.

JAP notification event — Japan is briefed on a development in VIE's politics under PM Vinh. Single option — triggers VIE_Vinh.7 for VIE after 12 hours. Pure bridge event for the JAP-VIE diplomatic track.

VIE receives a Japanese diplomatic initiative under PM Vinh. Effects: VIE-JAP opinion improved; favoritism and influence adjusted; FRA opinion modifiers applied regarding Japan's growing friendship with VIE. France is notified of the growing Japan-VIE relationship.

JAP decision event with two options about a specific initiative regarding VIE under PM Vinh. Option A triggers VIE_Vinh.9 for VIE (favorable outcome); Option B triggers VIE_Vinh.10 (unfavorable). Japan at a fork in its Vietnam policy.

VIE receives a favorable Japanese decision. Effects: +15 PP; +5% democratic popularity; adjusted favoritism/influence; triggers the news event VIE_Vinh.0 (public announcement). A positive diplomatic milestone for PM Vinh.
VIE receives an unfavorable Japanese decision. Effects: -15 PP. A setback for PM Vinh's Japan policy. Single option.

Second JAP decision event in the Vinh track. Two options: Option A triggers VIE_Vinh.12 for VIE (major investment); Option B triggers VIE_Vinh.13 (minor rejection). Japan deciding on a larger infrastructure commitment.

VIE receives Japan's major infrastructure investment. Effects: +5 PP; +5% democratic popularity; upgrades state 1758 (Hue/Phu Xuan) with infrastructure and industrial complex; adds tourism infrastructure. The largest economic payoff in the Vinh PM track.
VIE receives Japan's minor rejection. Effects: -5 PP. Small setback in the Vinh-Japan infrastructure chain. Single option.

Critical event: Tran Quang Vinh is promoted as VIE's democratic head of state. Effects: promotes Vinh as leader; sets politics to democratic elections disabled; adds corps commanders with traits; triggers VIE_Vinh.15 for FRA. This is the culminating event of the Vinh PM track — his transition to head of state.
FRA notification event — France learns of Vinh's elevation to head of state. Single option — triggers VIE_PMs.6 for VIE after 7 days. Bridge event passing the chain forward.
